structure_policy_rationale: 参考主题中 Alipay 和 Douban 的案例表明，该风格严格保留原始图形的几何轮廓和空间布局，仅进行材质维度的转换。微信读书的图标由明确的几何图形（书本底边+气泡）构成，符合‘清晰符号’的定义，因此必须完整保留其二维剪影结构，将其整体转化为具有厚度的3D冰雕，不可重构为真实书籍场景。
preserve: 底部书本开口的V型几何特征
气泡在画面右下象限的位置比例
气泡内两点眼睛的排列
整体图形的扁平化剪影轮廓在3D化后的投影一致性
must_preserve: 底部中央向下凹陷的书本展开形态（V型切口）
右下角白色气泡及其内部两个圆点（眼睛）的相对位置
气泡尾部的指向性角度
recompose_allowed: 将原本的平面色块转换为具有次表面散射（SSS）效果的半透明冰体
在冰体内部增加雪花、气泡或冰裂纹理以丰富细节
边缘处理为圆润的倒角，模拟冰块融化感
增加底部的接触阴影和微量水迹以增强落地感
restyle: 应用统一的 Pale Cyan/Ice Blue 半透明材质
移除所有原始品牌色（深蓝/天蓝），转为冰蓝色调
表面添加冷凝水珠和内部嵌入雪花纹理
decorate: 底部添加柔和的接触阴影和微小融水 puddle
高光反射强调冰质光泽和边缘折射
forbid: 禁止保留原始的深蓝色背景，必须转为纯白背景
禁止将气泡替换为真实的对话文字或复杂场景
禁止使用不透明的塑料质感，必须体现冰的通透性
禁止改变书本底边的开口角度或气泡的相对位置
禁止生成平面2D矢量风格
generation_brief: 3D ice sculpture icon of WeChat Reading. Shape: exact silhouette of original logo featuring a bottom base with a V-shaped book opening and a speech bubble with two dot-eyes in the lower right. Material: translucent pale cyan ice with internal bubbles, snowflake textures, and condensation droplets. Lighting: glossy highlights, subsurface scattering, refraction. Background: pure white with soft contact shadow and small water puddle at base. No outlines, no original colors.
color_application: Discard original brand blues. Apply uniform 'frozen water' aesthetic using Pale Cyan and Ice Blue. Use translucency and light refraction to define form instead of color contrast.
stroke_application: Eliminate all 2D strokes. Convert flat edges into rounded, beveled 3D ice contours defined by specular highlights and refraction rather than drawn lines.
composition_application: Center the 3D ice object occupying 70-80% of canvas. Maintain the spatial relationship between the book base and the floating bubble. Add a virtual ground plane with contact shadow.
identity_application: Preserve the exact geometric silhouette of the book's V-notch and the bubble's position/internal dots. Express identity through shape fidelity within the ice material, not through original colors.
fidelity_constraints: Must use unified semi-transparent ice blue material.
Must include internal bubbles, snowflakes, or ice crack textures.
Subject must have significant 3D volume and thickness.
negative_constraints: No opaque plastic or metal materials.
No distortion of the core logo silhouette (book V-shape and bubble dots).
